details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1, K2, K3, K4, K6, K7, K10, and K11. K5 (strategic targets) is missing entirely. K8 (sustainability initiatives) and K9 (product/service launches) are also missing entirely. K12 (management board appointment) is missing. While several HIGH importance criteria are covered, the missing HIGH importance K5 and missing MEDIUM criteria K8, K9, K12 result in a mixed coverage profile. The main picture is captured but with notable omissions of strategic targets and specific operational developments.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements are logically connected without contradictions. The narrative flows from overall financial performance to specific drivers, asset growth, strategic actions, and future outlook. Explanations for profit decline (interest rate environment) align with reported figures (net interest income decrease). Strategic actions (covered bonds, EIB agreement) are presented as responses to funding needs. All metrics (ratios, growth figures) are used consistently without internal conflict. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the organization progresses logically from results to causes to actions to outlook.
